ns2:section.sectionText: This is a hybrid course, meeting once a week in a room large enough for social distancing. The preference is to meet in-person every Monday from 1pm-3:50 but we will be following guidelines and adjusting as necessary. Weather permitting, we may meet outdoors on a Krannert Center terrace or in the Amphitheater. In these cases, our model will be clothed. In some cases, we may opt to stay at home and live-stream the modeling sessions. In this case, I would work with the model on-site and live-stream the poses and instruction to students in their own home. Students will be encouraged to work standing at an easel. If necessary, easels may be borrowed from campus with advance permission.
